rows.jp: 坂で少女とぶつかった。
rows.en: I ran smack into a girl on the hill.

ghs.en: On the hills I bumped into a girl.

rows.jp: 「きゃ……いったたたぁ……どこ見て歩いてんのよー、このスカタン！」
rows.en: “Ow... Owww... Watch where you're going, dumbass!”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Kyah... owChChCh...! Where're ya looking when you're walking, ya scut!"

rows.jp: 「く……なんだよ、そっちがよそ見してるのが悪いんだろー！」
rows.en: “Ghk... You're the one who wasn't watching where you were going!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Guh... the hell is that, it's your fault, you're the one who wasn't looking dammit!"

rows.jp: 「最初にぶつかった時から、好きだったの！」
rows.en: “I've loved you since the instant we ran into each other!”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "I've liked this ever since the first time I bumped into you!"
ghs.assessment: Nanaka says she has liked Taichi since they first collided. The English makes the object an unspecified 'this,' losing the person she professes to like.
ghs.remedy: I've liked you since the first time we bumped into each other!

rows.en: She threw her arms around me.

ghs.en: I am embraced.

rows.en: “Fast! This is moving way too fast!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "AHEHHH! Progress is too fast!"

rows.jp: こんな高速なステロみたことねー。
rows.en: I had never seen a meet-cute hit warp speed before.

ghs.en: Never seen a more stereotyped high geeear!
Taichi: "...I'll just come out and ask, who'd you be?"
Nanaka: "Nanaka."
Taichi: "Nanaka... yeah, nice name!"
Nanaka: "Thank ye."

rows.jp: 「まああたしが何者かについては、続く調査を待つとして」
rows.en: “As for the question of what I am, we’ll have to await further investigation.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Well, as for who or what exactly I am, we're awaiting for the investigation in progress."
Taichi: "Aren't you a ghost?"
Nanaka: "Ahhh, I think that's wrong, yes."

rows.jp: 「見た感じ、かなりゴースティックなんだが」%N※ゴースティック＝ゴースト的な

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Wrong, yes. Unlike specters, I have legs."

rows.jp: 「いや……それは……最近のゴーストってけっこう足あるし……」
rows.en: “That doesn’t prove much... Modern ghosts have feet all the time...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Naaah... it's just... lately even the specters got some leg..."

rows.jp: 「まああたしが何者かについては、続く調査を待つとして」
rows.en: “As for the question of what I am, we’ll have to await further investigation.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Well, as for who or what exactly I am, we're awaiting for the investigation in progress."
Discussion coercively averted.
Taichi: "...nah, we're fine."

rows.en: “Here. I’ll give you my business card.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Then let me hand over to you my business card."
I take it.

rows.jp: %Nあなたのハァト、癒してあ・げ・る♪
rows.en: %NLet me heal your li'l ol' heart for you ♥

ghs.en:
JOB:   Next Generation Bishuojo
NAME: ~NANACA~
Your heart I! will! heal!♪
Taichi: "......"

rows.en: Where was I even supposed to start?

ghs.en: Where do I even begin to straight-man this?
Nanaka: "Hehe～hn."

rows.jp: 七香とやらは誇らしげな、それこそ、
rows.en: Nanaka—or whoever she was—shot me a proud sidelong look.

ghs.en: Nanaka might just have been proud of this thing.
『Do feel free to fall in love with me!』

rows.jp: という不二子クラスの顔つきで俺に流し目を送ってきた。

ghs.en: That is what her Fujiko-class face said as she sent a flirtatious sidelong glance towards me.
Taichi: "Nanaka's misromanized."
Nanaka: "It's on purpose."

rows.jp: 急にマジ顔。つうか怒ってる。
rows.en: Her face went instantly serious. No—angry.

ghs.en: Face goes serious in a flash. Anger's going through it.
Taichi: "......"
Is she... dangerous?

rows.jp: 敏腕ヤングアダルトとして名高い俺に、感じ取れない空気はない。
rows.en: As a celebrated hotshot young adult, I could read any room.

ghs.en: For the me celebrate in his competence as a Young Adult, there is no atmosphere that I can't fully grasp.
ghs.assessment: The English uses the noun/verb 'celebrate' where a participle such as 'celebrated' is required and builds an ungrammatical subject phrase.
ghs.remedy: As a young adult renowned for his competence

highlights.text: For the me celebrate in his competence as a Young Adult

ghs.en: And it was proclaiming,
that this girl was dangerous.

rows.jp: だって、どう考えてもミスじゃん。ありえねー。
rows.en: Because come on, it was obviously a typo. No way it wasn't.

ghs.en: And yet... prodding the madman in front any further than this is in no way a good plan.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese calls the woman he is facing a mad person. The English changes her gender and leaves 'in front' without the required complement.
ghs.remedy: the madwoman in front of me

rows.jp: だが……狂人相手にこれ以上つつくのは得策ではない。
rows.en: But poking the crazy woman any further would be a bad idea.

rows.jp: 「君って激キュートだけど、ご用件は？」
rows.en: “You're super cute and all, but what do you want?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "You're like Ultra Kyute, but, what's your business?"

rows.jp: 「いやー、さっきのは爽快だったよねー」
rows.en: “Boy, what happened earlier sure felt good.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Welll, that thing earlier was sooo exhilarating yannow."
In an instant her mood corrected back to good.

rows.jp: 危険人物特有の反応だ。

ghs.en: It's a reaction peculiar to dangerous characters.

rows.en: “The way that woman writhed in agony!”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "That way that broad suffered in agony!"
Giggling laughter.
Taichi: "You saw that?"
Nanaka: "Gave a glance."
Nanaka: "So refreshing!"

rows.jp: 「……曜子ちゃんのこと、嫌いなんだ？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...then, Youko-chan... you hate her right?"
Nanaka: "She's a bad woman. Bleeech, she is, just bleeech."

rows.jp: 「君と曜子ちゃんの関係がわからん……」
rows.en: “I don’t understand your relationship with her...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I'm not sure I get where you're connected with Youko-chan..."

rows.jp: 「ないよ。会ったことないし。ただムカつく」
rows.en: “There isn’t one. We’ve never met. She just pisses me off.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Nowhere! We never met not once. She's just irritating."

rows.jp: 「だから今朝は気分いいんだー」
rows.en: “That's why I'm in such a good mood this morning.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "That's why this morning's felt sooo nice yes."
Taichi: "Ah, so that is what it is then."

rows.jp: 「だから今週は轢(ひ)かないであげました」
rows.en: “That’s why I decided not to run you over this week.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Therefore, this week I graciously avoided striking you and making you tumble down."
ghs.assessment: Nanaka specifically says she refrained from running Taichi over with a vehicle that week. The English removes the vehicle and recasts it as a generic collision and fall.
ghs.remedy: didn't run you over this week

highlights.text: avoided striking you and making you tumble down

ghs.en: Huh, not struck and made to tumble down?
No clue what she means.

rows.jp: 「よくないよねー、あーいう人」
rows.en: “People like her are awful, don’t you think?”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "She ain't good at all, no, that person o'er there."

rows.jp: 「……すっごい嫌いだってのは伝わってきた」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...you're conveying me feelings of reeeal big hatred."
ghs.assessment: The verb construction is ungrammatical; a person conveys feelings to someone or gets a feeling across.
ghs.remedy: you've made your intense hatred clear to me

rows.jp: 「嫌いっていうか、間違ってるじゃない」
rows.en: “It's not about hating her. She's wrong.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Hatred you say, well you aren't mistaken."
ghs.assessment: Nanaka says it is not so much that she dislikes Youko as that Youko is wrong. The English instead tells Taichi his claim of hatred is correct.
ghs.remedy: It's not that I hate her—she's wrong.

highlights.text: Hatred you say, well you aren't mistaken.

ghs.en: Taichi: "So..."

rows.jp: どこまで知ってるんだろう？

ghs.en: How much does she even know?

rows.jp: 「あんな女に……太一の最初を取られるくらいだったら……あたしが……」
rows.en: “Rather than let a woman like that be your first... I’d...”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "That broad... she even took my Taichi's first she did... that's why I..."
ghs.assessment: Nanaka says that rather than let a woman like Youko take Taichi's first time, Nanaka would act. The English falsely states that Youko already took it.
ghs.remedy: Rather than let a woman like that take your first time, Taichi... I would...

highlights.text: she even took my Taichi's first she did

ghs.en: She went gloomy.
Taichi: "First?"

rows.jp: 「あー、やなこと思い出した。ペッペッ。忘れよ」
rows.en: “Oh, that reminds me of something awful. Ptooey. Forget it.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Ahhh, I remembered something bad. Ptui! Forget it!"
Taichi: "Ah, uhm."
Nanaka: "Palate cleanser!♪"
Pchk.
Taichi: "Wh-, what, why?!"

rows.jp: 「いいじゃん、減るものじゃないし」
rows.en: “Why not? It's not like you lost anything.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "That's fine, that's not like that's the end of the world!"

rows.jp: 「なんか、妙に焦った……敏腕アダルトであるこの俺が……」
rows.en: “That actually rattled me... me, a hotshot adult...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Really, getting this oddly flustered... even this Competent Adult that I am..."

rows.jp: 「ま、あんな女のことはどーでもいいや」

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Well, about that broad, it's all whaaat-ever now."

rows.jp: 「太一ぃ、くれぐれも惑わされないようにね？」
rows.en: “Taichi, don't let her seduce you, okay?”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Taichi, please don't go get confused this earnestly now, will ya?"
ghs.assessment: Nanaka earnestly warns him to be very careful not to be misled. The English modifies 'confused' with 'earnestly,' producing the wrong relation and an unnatural instruction.
ghs.remedy: be very careful not to let her mislead you

highlights.text: don't go get confused this earnestly

rows.jp: 「そらまあ……されないと思うけどさ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Well, now... but no, I don't think I will."

rows.jp: 本当、なんなんだろう、この人。

ghs.en: Really, what is even up with this person here.

rows.jp: 存在している密度がまるで感じられない。
rows.en: It was as if her existence had no density at all.

ghs.en: I can't fully feel the weight of her existence,
there is just no presence.

rows.jp: 「あのね、今日はちょっとマジでさ」

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Say now, today I'm a bit serious, yeah."
Taichi: "Huh?"

rows.jp: 「ちょっとこれから、あたしと一緒に祠に来て欲しいんだ」
rows.en: “I want you to come to the shrine with me now.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "And I want you to come to the hokora together with me right now."
Taichi: "What for? Rape?"
Nanaka: "You wish!"

rows.jp: 「そーじゃなくて、真面目な話。祠、知ってるでしょ？」
rows.en: “No, I mean it. This is serious. You know the shrine, right?”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Nooothing of the sort, I'm talking serious. You know that hokora, right?"
Taichi: "Yeah, sorta."

rows.jp: あまり近寄りたい場所じゃないけど。
rows.en: Not that I particularly wanted to go near it.

ghs.en: It's not some place I really wanna get close to, though.
Because that place is---

rows.jp: 「こーいうのは、ちょっと恐いんだけど……来てほしいんだ」
rows.en: “This kind of thing scares me a little... so I want you with me.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Bit scary to do it like this, but... I want you to come with me."

rows.jp: 「だって太一、あの女に比べて調査甘いんだもん」

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Because Taichi, you're so lax in your investigations compared to that woman."
Taichi: "That woman'd be Youko-chan?"

rows.en: “...It pains me to admit it, but she’s good.”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "...it's frustrating, but she's superlative."

rows.jp: 「脳みその使い方からして違うからね」
rows.en: “She uses her brain differently from the rest of us.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Because she's just different even in the way she uses her brain."

rows.jp: 「あまり考えない方がいいよ、そこらへん」
rows.en: “Better not to think too hard about it.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Best not to think too much about those things."
Nanaka: "Is it now."
ghs.assessment: Nanaka agrees with Taichi's advice. The English instead turns the response into a skeptical question.

rows.jp: 「ね、お願い！　これからちょっとつきあって！」
rows.en: “Come on, please! Just humor me for a little while!”

ghs.en: Nanaka: "Well, if you please! Keep me company a bit right now."

rows.en: She clasped her hands and begged.

ghs.en: She joined my hand with hers.
ghs.assessment: Nanaka presses her own palms together in a pleading gesture. The English instead makes her take and join Taichi's hand.

highlights.text: She joined my hand with hers.
